about: Reval sends its own events next to PostHog's: one per dialog opened and one per click, field or button. A dialog is a Reval window (a trade, a report's parameters, a list); messages Reval shows (errors, confirmations) arrive as events of their own.

dialog.name: dialog_id
dialog.meaning: The Reval dialog (window) the event happened in, a stable code like DlgDetailIRSwap. Special values: messagebox (a message Reval showed), toast (a short notice), menuCmb (the menu and search bar).

dialogName.name: dialog_name
dialogName.meaning: The dialog's title as the user sees it, e.g. "IR Swap". UNKNOWN on messages; use dialog for grouping.

tab.name: tab_name
tab.meaning: The tab inside the dialog, e.g. Terms, Cashflow, Parameters.

action.name: action
action.meaning: On PageView: OPEN, FOCUS or CLOSE of the dialog. On Event: the field's label ("Trade Date"), DOUBLECLICK on a row, the text typed into the search bar, or a generated id like gridfloatedit-3404-inputEl for unlabelled grid cells.

control.name: control_type
control.meaning: What kind of control: TEXTFIELD, DATEFIELD, DROPDOWN, CHECKBOX, SEARCH (search text), SEARCHTYPE (what is searched), MENU, ROW (a grid row), RIGHTCLICK.

button.name: action_name
button.meaning: The button pressed (Save, Run, Apply, Export...) or a grid operation (applyFilter, loadGrid). On messagebox and toast events, a list whose first item is the message text.

version.name: title
version.meaning: The window title with the release, e.g. "REVAL 27.0.0". Only on some PageView events.

outcomes.match: has been scheduled|is scheduled|has been queued
outcomes.note: a job or report was queued; it finishes later
nothing to show or nothing selected
